methods: SHA-256 comparison across all 215 supplied files and every existing catalog record
Normalized extracted-text comparison against 607 previously published PDFs
PDF page counts plus embedded author, creator, creation and modification metadata
Visual fingerprints for all 1,624 PDF pages, including cross-archive comparison against 526 page-count-compatible published PDFs
OCR attempted on 263 representative image-only pages; 242 pages produced usable text
Rendered inspection of the highest-similarity certification, laboratory and field-photo candidates

decisions.name: Biosolids audit transmittal
decisions.reason: Two three-page files have identical normalized text and identical rendered pages. The clearly named Cadillac WWTP copy is retained; the alternate word-export copy is suppressed.

decisions.name: Field photographs IMG_0020 and IMG_0021
decisions.reason: Both PDFs contain the same 640-by-480 field photograph with only border/crop differences. The version with the larger image area is retained and the alternate export is suppressed.

decisions.name: Three records already in the permit archive
decisions.reason: Two permit/compliance records and one 2017 management-practices certification are exact byte matches to existing sources, so their stable links are reused rather than republishing copies.

decisions.name: 2017 and 2018 certification forms
decisions.reason: Near-identical templates carry different signed dates and reporting periods. They remain distinct records, and the supplied duplicate labels are not carried forward.

decisions.name: TVS logs, as-applied workbooks and site forms
decisions.reason: Visual similarity reflects common templates. Different years, site IDs, monitoring values and application dates make these distinct evidence records.

decisions.name: Approximately 22,000-gallon biosolids overflow note
decisions.reason: The photographed note is indexed as an incident/spill record. Its stated volume is preserved, while migration or environmental impact is not inferred from the note alone.

decisions.name: Former duplicate-labeled files
decisions.reason: Every retained file was evaluated on content, metadata and page evidence. The word 'Duplicates_' was removed from all retained titles; a label alone was never treated as proof of duplicate content.
